scenario: AITA for telling my girlfriend that I don't care about what she is talking about? | Throwaway account. Last night my girlfriend and I were hanging out on the couch. I was in the middle of reading an article and she just started talking about stupid things (like what would happen if someone's eyeball popped out of socket) so I turned to her and said "I'm trying to read this article and I don't really care about what you're talking about." I didn't hear from her for the rest of the night and today she is talking to me but only one or two word responses. So AITA?
